canonical_project: SPIC (State Power Investment) Gui'an Data Center Phase 1
owner: SPIC (Gui'an New Area) Data Center Co., Ltd.
notes: Phase 1 building area 14,035.26 sqm (A3 data-center building ~14,000 sqm), part of SPIC's power-industry digital chain; 2023-10 reporting said construction in full swing to relocate SPIC Beijing data center workloads to Gui'an by 2023-11. SPIC Gui'an Data Center Co. registered capital raised to RMB 298 mn (2026-04). No rack/MW disclosed.
